question: Should ClawHub add a first-class SKILL.md capability manifest for skills, and what schema, authority model, and advisory-to-required rollout should it use?
rationale: This changes the public skill trust boundary and security-review contract; source inspection can confirm it is missing, but automation cannot choose the permanent schema or rollout policy.

options.title: Adopt advisory manifest first
options.body: Define the capability schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-vs-observed mismatches before any required gate.

options.title: Defer to scanner inference
options.body: Keep using existing env/install metadata plus ClawScan coherence review, accepting that authors still have no standard declared baseline for these capabilities.

options.title: Require manifests immediately
options.body: Make new submissions include the capability block from day one, which gives a stronger contract but needs sharper legacy and false-positive policy first.

recommendation.title: Adopt advisory manifest first
recommendation.body: Define the capability schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-vs-observed mismatches before any required gate.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses CODEOWNERS-listed schema, moderation, scanner, and security documentation paths where this handle is the strongest routing signal.
